diagnostic_evidence.quote: Using the Cauchy-Schwarz inequality and Sobolev embedding $H^{1+\alpha}(\Omega) \hookrightarrow L^\infty(\Omega)$:

issues.failure_explanation: At α=1, H^{1+α}=H^2 controls u in L∞ but does not control ∂_{x_1}u in L∞. The nonlinear energy estimate requires ||∂_{x_1}u_N||_{L∞} with a constant independent of N, and the uniqueness Gronwall estimate requires ||∂_{x_1}(\bar u+\bar w)||_{L∞} bounded by H^{1+α} norms. Both bounds are not available at the lower endpoint α=1 from the stated hypotheses.
issues.least_adequate_overall_repair: Restrict the convergence and well-posedness results to α>1, or add a small amount of extra regularity (e.g. H^{1+α+ε}) at α=1; no source-supported proof for the full endpoint α=1 is given.
issues.overall_effect: The uniform H^{1+α} bound \eqref{bd3}, uniqueness, convergence of the semi-discrete solutions, and the well-posedness theorem fail at the advertised endpoint α=1.
issues.title: Endpoint α=1 estimates use unavailable W^{1,∞} bounds
issues.why_classification: A limited weakening (excluding the endpoint or adding standard extra regularity) preserves the main results for α>1, but the advertised full range α∈[1,2] is not established as written.
